case_number: Criminal Appeal No. ............. of 2023 [Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No.2358 of 2023]

parties.respondent: The State of NCT of Delhi

summary: Pre-arrest bail under CrPC s.438; imposition of deposit condition for bail; undertaking by accused to deposit Rs.22 lakh; excess over amount allegedly received; impermissible conversion of bail into recovery mechanism; precedent in Munish Bhasin; High Court's condition quashed; bail upheld without deposit requirement; judicial restraint in imposing monetary conditions; protection against misuse of process.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.420, s.406, s.34
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.438, s.482
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; condition of deposit set aside; anticipatory bail upheld without monetary condition.
